_readme: Measured aggregate output throughput per model replica. Add rows from your own runs (vLLM benchmark_serving, TensorRT-LLM trtllm-bench, SGLang bench_serving) or from a published, reproducible source. A row is only used when gpu + model + precision + tp (+ pp) match exactly and aggregate_output_tps.value is a number. When no row matches, the app falls back to the THEORETICAL bandwidth/compute roofline estimate and labels it as such.

aggregate_output_tps.source: Example row: replace with a measured value. Left empty on purpose so no invented benchmark is used.
